name: Example: Using the Power of Quotient Rule with Two Fractions
worked_solution:
First, we apply the power of quotient rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}{(\frac{y}{2})}^{3}{(\frac{2y}{3})}^{2}=\frac{{y}^{3}}{{2}^{3}}\cdot \frac{(2y)^{2}}{{3}^{2}}\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we apply the power rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{y}^{3}}{{2}^{3}}\cdot \frac{(2y)^{2}}{{3}^{2}} & = \\ \frac{{y}^{3}}{8}\cdot \frac{{2}^{2}{y}^{2}}{9} & = \\ \frac{{y}^{3}}{8}\cdot \frac{4{y}^{2}}{9}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we apply the product rule and simplify:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{y}^{3}}{8}\cdot \frac{4{y}^{2}}{9} & = \\ \frac{4{y}^{(3+2)}}{72} & = \\ \frac{4{y}^{5}}{72} & = \\ \frac{{y}^{5}}{18}\end{aligned}
$$
